about: Fresh phrasings written blind (no access to crisis.js or crisis-corpus.json) by nine voices: passive ideation, plans and means, teens, veterans, postpartum, faith framing, worry for others and danger, Spanish, and hard negatives. Written October 2026 to find gaps the pooled corpus had been tuned to. Reported by npm run eval:crisis.
